requirement.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirement.sourceText: In category A and B ships constructed on or after 1 January 2026, the bridge wings shall be enclosed or designed to protect navigational equipment and operating personnel. On ships which cannot comply with this regulation, arrangements acceptable to the Administration shall be provided to achieve a level of protection that is equivalent to this regulation.
